description: This file defines a React functional component 'QRCodeViewer' that fetches a prescription QR payload from an API, generates a QR code image, and displays it along with related information. It manages state, handles asynchronous data fetching and QR code generation, and renders conditional UI based on load/error states.

methods.name: QRCodeViewer
methods.description: React component that displays a QR code for a given prescription ID, fetching payload data and rendering QR image and payload info.
